actual: The factor library UI exposes Generate/Update Official Shared Cache and Force Recompute Official Cache as separate full-scope actions, but the WSL official batch compute never consumes force and both actions recompute all enabled factors. Operators only need two explicit scopes: compute selected factors and full compute all available factors for a new official window. Consolidate the full-scope UI action, make scope and cache replacement semantics explicit, preserve selected-factor compute, add plan/confirmation feedback, and do not cancel or mutate any currently running compute task.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
